correctness.rationale: A non-surjective idempotent must fix a unique contiguous image arc. The omitted complementary path maps to a lazy walk in that arc, proving E_(n,l+1)=n(B_l^(n-l))_(0,l). Tridiagonal cofactor/resolvent gives n[z^(n-2l)]D_(l+1)^(-1). The Perron eigenvalue 1+2cos(pi/(l+2)) and its positive endpoint projection yield phase Phi(x)=x log 3+pi²/(3x²) at l=x n^(1/3); the unique saddle gives the c and kappa constants, with outer tails bounded by lambda_l^N. Step-sum closure yields |W_n|=n(T_n+2). Independent complete step-sequence enumeration for 3<=n<=8 verified every rank and monoid count, including (n,E_n,|W_n|)=(6,157,858) and (8,1025,8872). Asymptotic arguments, not small counts, support the n->infinity result.
